page.overview:
Who is Daramon?

Daramon is an old teacher of the Dayal Hall. As an NPC, he is played by Matthew Mercer.

Daramon is a very old man, with a bald head and a big white beard that makes him look like all his hair moved down his face.

Daramon used to be a teacher, and he became Ajit Dayal's mentor, who eventually decided to dedicate himself to teaching too. When Daramon became too old, his former student started taking care of him, although he still stayed in the Dayal Hall, being a valued member due to his knowledge.

During the apogee solstice of 843 PD Chetney, Fearne and Orym visited the Dayal Hall to learn about the current situation in Jrusar, and took the chance to ask about a very old magical harness they had found in Molaesmyr. Ajit decided to bring Daramon to them, since he would be the only one who might have knowledge about such ancient arcane matters; however, after inspecting the device the old man confirmed he knew nothing about it, and left to finish his soup.
